headlines.text: 2025 brought us this moment: the AEW Unified Title made its debut as Kazuchika Okada vs. Kenny Omega battled for the honor of being first champion, appearing on All In: Texas, rated 8.60 ? a match that lived up to every bit of hype. In the inaugural Unified Championship match, Okada hit the Rainmaker to defeat Omega, tying their legendary series at 2-2-1.

It was 2023 when Nick Wayne didn't ease in ? their first AEW match was the main event against Swerve Strickland, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.54 ? a match that delivered. Fresh off turning 18 the day before, the third-generation prodigy made his AEW debut against Swerve Strickland, pushing him to the limit before falling to the JML Driver ? a performance that got him signed on the spot.

On a Saturday in 2025, back when there was a changing of the guard for the AEW World Heavyweight Title as Adam Page vs. Jon Moxley battled it out in a Texas Death Match, appearing on All In: Texas, rated 9.62 ? an all-time classic ? ending the champion's reign at 8 defenses. In a chaotic Texas Death Match main event featuring interference from Bryan Danielson, Darby Allin, Swerve Strickland and Will Ospreay, Page forced Moxley to tap to a chain choke, ending the Death Riders' hold on the AEW World Title.

secondaries.text: That Saturday in 2025, Toni Storm vs. Mercedes Mone went to battle over the AEW Women's World Title, appearing on All In: Texas, rated 8.84 ? a stone-cold classic. This stood as the 70th match in AEW Women's World Title history ? a real piece of championship history. Storm hit an avalanche Storm Zero to retain the AEW Women's World Title, handing Mon? her first-ever one-on-one loss in AEW.

That Saturday in 2025, a new champion was crowned for the AEW TNT Title as Dustin Rhodes vs. Daniel Garcia vs. Kyle Fletcher vs. Sammy Guevara battled it out, appearing on All In: Texas, rated 4.97 ? ending the champion's reign at 4 defenses. It marked Daniel Garcia's 10th match with the title on the line. With Adam Cole forced to vacate the TNT Title over a health issue, Rhodes rolled up Garcia in a four-way also involving Fletcher and Guevara to win the vacant championship.

Back on this day in 2025, AEW welcomed Syuri for the first time in a Casino Gauntlet match against Athena vs. Alex Windsor vs. Julia Hart vs. Kris Statlander vs. Megan Bayne vs. Mina Shirakawa vs. Queen Aminata vs. Tay Melo vs. Thekla vs. Thunder Rosa vs. Willow Nightingale, appearing on All In: Texas, rated 7.56 ? a good, competitive contest. Syuri competed in the record-breaking 20-plus-entrant Women's Casino Gauntlet, ultimately won by Athena in a match that reshaped the entire women's title picture.
